mathematics.implementation: Transfer signed jumpCyclic face jumps through the shared LDU view. Assemble j=sum(boundaryCoefficient*signedJump) on CUDA. Add j to the initial A*T only. Preserve original b and row sums for native OpenFOAM normFactor; all Krylov matvecs remain linear A*p. Read actual boundary jump values rather than relying on a copied vector satisfying field identity.
mathematics.ordinary_path: No affine allocation/upload/kernel when no jump field is present. Same solver object is tested after changing jump fields to ordinary cyclic.
mathematics.scope: Shared sparse bridge used by CHT solid conduction; no case-specific production dispatch, host solver fallback, new physical stopping gate or README modification.
